title: NAVI_EYES_WIDE_OPEN historical impostor challenge
scope: Repository evidence replay only; no firmware or threshold changes

rules.substantial_event: absolute Hall departure >= 70 counts for two consecutive native samples
rules.polarity: opening polarity only; later return flux cannot overwrite it
rules.ir_window: measured travel / mapped interval must be within 0.85..1.15
rules.pwm_zero: PWM=0 is not locomotive route movement
rules.ir_policy: no synchronized IR distance is manufactured from PWM or elapsed time

limitations: The documented ONE STRIKE captures predate the native-rate synchronized IR recorder.
Therefore every historical full-model result is explicitly IR-unavailable unless a source says otherwise.
A null IR distance or ratio is evidence of missing instrumentation, not a zero-distance result.
